exposure: Ultrasound estimated epidural depth (ED) in the paramedian sagittal oblique plane (PSO)
Ultrasound estimated epidural depth (ED) in the transverse median plane (TM)
outcome: Accuracy of ultrasound estimated ED compared to actual ND
cohort: 90 parturients scheduled for cesarean section asking for combined spinal epidural anesthesia.
finding: There was a strong correlation between actual epidural depth (ND) and ultrasound estimates of epidural depth in both the PSO and TM planes.
